source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT TOP 10
    s.name AS NomeSchema,
    t.name AS NomeTabella
FROM 
    sys.tables t
INNER JOIN 
    sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
ORDER BY 
    NomeSchema, 
    NomeTabella;
